meta.title: Contact us and request a quote
meta.description: Request a tailored quote for home, housekeeping or commercial cleaning in Luxembourg. We reply within one working day.

hero.title: Tell us about your home or premises
hero.intro: Every quote is tailored. Share a few details and we will reply within one working day to discuss your needs and arrange a visit if useful.

image.alt: A leather lounge chair in a bright, quiet room with a single plant

form.title: Request a quote
form.intro: Fields marked optional can be left blank. The more you tell us, the more precise our first answer.

steps.title: We call or email you
steps.body: Within one working day, using the contact method you prefer.

steps.title: We visit if useful
steps.body: A short, free visit to understand the space, the surfaces and your expectations.

steps.title: You receive a written quote
steps.body: A clear scope and price, excluding and including VAT, with no obligation.
